dates: (28 Nov 1810-15 April 1900)
---

sister-in-law of the Very Rev. William John Butler

Second cousin of the Very Rev. William Butler, who was married to her younger sister Emma Barnett, she supported his good works at Wantage.  She lived with her father George Henry Barnett (d. 1871) and younger sister Louisa at Glympton and in Wilton Crescent. [H. Barnett, Glympton;  LG 1952 Barnett formerly of Glympton]
